name: Spotify
author: ingermanr
description: Control Spotify from the Omarchy bar: play/pause, next/previous, current track, track search, main artists, and playlists.

barWidget.description: Spotify playback control and quick search from the bar.

schema.label: Main artists
schema.description: Comma-separated artist names shown in the Main artists section, e.g. Radiohead, Portishead, Massive Attack. Leave empty to use your personal Spotify top artists (needs a user access token).

schema.label: Spotify Client ID
schema.description: Required for search and playlists. Get it from https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard

schema.label: Spotify Client Secret
schema.description: Required for search and playlists. Stored in plain text in your Omarchy shell config.

schema.label: Spotify Access Token
schema.description: Optional bearer token used directly for Spotify API calls instead of client credentials flow.
